title: SA/21/2015 of Jeevan Lal Sah Vs Bhupendra Singh Rana AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
SA No. 21 of 2015
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate for
the appellant.
None turns up on behalf of the
respondents.
Learned counsel for the appellant
has moved an application for withdrawal
(CLMA No. 15534/2017) with the
submissions that the mitigating parties
have settled their scores amicably. So,
he wants to take this appeal back.
The application is hereby allowed.
Appeal is hereby dismissed as
withdrawn.
Interim relief application (CLMA
No. 2344/2015) also stands disposed of.
